text: T171 is blocked: G1 stop rules hit. (1) Item 1 cause is DRAWING, not measurement: in the Mac app page starts are 0 px off at 75/50 %, but WebKit paints the paper gradient's px stops unzoomed, so grey gaps sit 1056 screen px apart at any zoom (1.png reproduced at 50 %). (2) Item 2: no caret/empty line in a real gap in Chromium (3 seeds) or WebKit (sweep+fuzz); 3.png reproduced natively as the SAME drawing bug at fit zoom ~0.83 (3.png's paper is ~677 CSS px wide): caret on page 2's real text drawn inside the misplaced grey band. (3) G2 as written (measure at zoom 1) would break WebKit, whose line heights change with zoom. (4) Acceptance 'pages-gap.spec fails on untouched tree' cannot be met; failing checks are pages-zoom.spec (Chromium fit zoom 1.1495 drift up to 4 px, 10 crossings) and the native gate pixels. Questions: confirm 3.png was a narrow window/split pane; re-plan G2 toward fixing the paper drawing (plus the small Chromium drift); how is G1 accepted? Details: docs/agent-work/2026-10-28-ui-wave-4/PAGES-DIAGNOSIS.md
resolution: Coordinator: diagnosis accepted. PLAN.md Amendment 1 replaces G1's acceptance (fail-first = pages-zoom.spec Chromium 1.1495 + native gate pixels; pages-gap.spec stays as a passing guard; gap-click behaviour unchanged) and re-scopes G2 (draw pages so they scale with zoom in WebKit; fix Chromium 1.1495 drift; do NOT measure at zoom 1) and G3 (no one-frame stale caret/empty line in the gap; visible selection after Backspace at a page break). Unblock T171 and submit it for review against Amendment 1.
